description: Department of Census and Statistics - The National Consumer Price Index - October - 2023
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index figure for October 2023, which is statistical data published by the Department of Census and Statistics. While it involves a government department, the content does not relate to government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) nor does it fit any of the specialized categories (4-9). It represents statistical reporting of economic data, which falls under general administrative matters not specifically covered by other categories.
